profile.headline: Aspiring Data Analyst · MSc Statistics · Python, SQL & Power BI
profile.summary: Statistics postgraduate from Patna University building a career in data analytics. I pair a strong foundation in statistical theory with practical skills in Python, SQL, Excel and Power BI to turn raw data into clear, decision-ready insights — and I am expanding into APIs and cloud data pipelines with FastAPI and AWS.
profile.academic_background: I completed both my BSc and MSc in Statistics at Patna University. My studies gave me a rigorous grounding in probability, statistical inference and quantitative methods — the mathematical core behind modern data analysis.
profile.statistics_overview: Statistics is the lens I bring to every dataset: understanding variability, testing whether a pattern is real or just noise, and communicating uncertainty honestly so that decisions rest on evidence.
profile.career_objective: To grow as a Data Analyst in an organisation where I can apply statistical thinking and modern analytics tools to real business problems — cleaning and modelling data, building dashboards and delivering insights that drive better decisions — while continuing to deepen my skills in data engineering and cloud technologies.

projects.title: Sales Data Analysis
projects.summary: Exploratory analysis of sales data to uncover trends across products, regions and time periods.
projects.description: An end-to-end analysis of a sales dataset: cleaning and preparing raw records, exploring performance by product, region and period, and presenting the findings as clear visual summaries for business stakeholders.
objectives: Clean and validate raw sales records
Compare performance across products and regions

projects.title: YouTube Channel Analytics
projects.summary: Analysing channel and video performance data to understand audience engagement patterns.
projects.description: A study of YouTube channel data that examines video-level metrics such as views, likes and comments to understand what drives engagement and how content performance changes over time.
objectives: Collect and structure video performance data

projects.title: AWS S3 → Lambda → RDS Pipeline
projects.summary: An event-driven pipeline that loads files uploaded to S3 into a relational database via Lambda.
projects.description: A serverless data pipeline on AWS: a file uploaded to an S3 bucket triggers a Lambda function written in Python, which reads, validates and transforms the data before inserting it into an RDS database for querying with SQL.
objectives: Trigger processing automatically on S3 upload
Parse and validate data inside Lambda
Load clean records into Amazon RDS

projects.title: Cloud-Based Fleet Performance Monitoring
projects.summary: A cloud-hosted approach to tracking and analysing vehicle fleet performance metrics.
projects.description: A monitoring solution that stores fleet operational data in the cloud and analyses performance indicators so that trends and issues can be reviewed through reports and dashboards.
objectives: Store fleet data in cloud services
Process data for key performance indicators
